verdict.rationale: Ente documents an export page with password-encrypted local backups, and an official CLI that can 'decrypt the export from Ente Auth'. The docs also reference 'Ente's plaintext export format', so secrets can be obtained in readable form. However, one community user reports you can't easily export into other apps' formats (e.g. Bitwarden/Aegis), which makes migrating away harder. Missing for 10: documented direct plaintext/otpauth export from the app UI, evidence that other authenticators import Ente's export format, independent hands-on confirmation of migrating away.
